changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE sequence_info record; BEGIN FOR sequence_info IN SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('actif', 'actif_seq'), ('affectation', 'affectation_seq'), ('affectation_actif', 'affectation_actif_seq'), ('agent', 'agent_seq'), ('bordereau', 'bordereau_seq'), ('categorie_materiel', 'categorie_materiel_seq'), ('contrat', 'contrat_seq'), ('equipement_recensement', 'equipement_recensement_seq'), ('fournisseur', 'fournisseur_seq'), ('historique_action', 'historique_action_seq'), ('intervention', 'intervention_seq'), ('inventaire', 'inventaire_seq'), ('jhi_user', 'jhi_user_seq'), ('maintenance', 'maintenance_seq'), ('panne', 'panne_seq'), ('planning_maintenance', 'planning_maintenance_seq'), ('rapport', 'rapport_seq'), ('recensement', 'recensement_seq'), ('service_dgi', 'service_dgi_seq'), ('transfert', 'transfert_seq'), ('transfert_actif', 'transfert_actif_seq') ) AS sequences(table_name, sequence_name) LOOP EXECUTE format( 'SELECT setval(%L, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM %I), 0) + 1, false)', sequence_info.sequence_name, sequence_info.table_name ); END LOOP; END $$;
